event_summary: A tan stick near a black round object moves toward the right-side row of blocks, after which several right-side blocks tip and come to rest leaning or lying while the duck and left-side blocks remain upright.
raw_event_description: The scene begins with a yellow toy duck centered on a wooden tabletop, with upright dark and pale rectangular blocks arranged in rows on both sides. A black round object sits behind the right-side row, with a thin tan stick visible near its top. After an initially still interval, the tan stick changes angle and extends toward the far-right block in the right-side row. The far-right dark block tilts leftward, followed by neighboring right-side blocks tipping and collapsing into a small pile. The duck stays upright, and the blocks on the left side remain upright through the end.

reasons: The duck, both rows of upright blocks, the black round object, and the tan stick are all visible.
The tabletop and wall background are unobstructed.
No scene-object motion is visible in the first frame.
